_about: Equilibrium bond lengths r_e of the diatomics, copied from NIST CCCBDB (Experimental > Geometry > Experimental geometries, expgeom2x.asp). The 'source' column is CCCBDB's own citation key for the value. CCCBDB lists no vibrational eigenvectors for diatomics; the build derives the stretch vector from the masses (see molecules3d.py).

source.database: NIST CCCBDB, NIST Standard Reference Database 101
